stakeholders.name: Enterprise Technology Buyer
stakeholders.role: Decision-maker at a mid-to-large enterprise evaluating GRC audit, custom development, or architecture consulting partners.
stakeholders.interest: Needs credible proof of capability and an easy way to start a conversation.

stakeholders.name: SMB / SaaS Founder
stakeholders.role: Owner or technical lead at a small-to-medium business or SaaS startup.
stakeholders.interest: Wants an accessible, trustworthy delivery partner and a low-friction contact path.

stakeholders.name: Logia Growth & BA Team
stakeholders.role: Internal team that receives and qualifies inbound inquiries.
stakeholders.interest: Wants qualified, well-structured leads (focus area, company, contact details) delivered reliably.

stakeholders.name: Site Visitor
stakeholders.role: Anonymous prospective visitor browsing the marketing site.
stakeholders.interest: Wants to quickly grasp the value proposition and offerings.
